summary: The test-only fix replaces a wall-clock calendar assumption with exact contract assertions: hosted and local-merged paths retain the merge timestamp, while locally-shipped reconciliation uses a frozen reconciliation timestamp.
findings: The pre-fix failure reproduces after UTC midnight and is isolated to the hard-coded 2026-08-03 assertion; production token aggregation is unchanged.
Fake time is scoped to one test and restored after every test, while all three paths now assert exact timestamps rather than weakening coverage.
residual_risks: The dedicated PR must pass the complete hosted unit matrix before main is treated as repaired.
